extraction_issues.quote: On the other hand, the regular SCF code easily achieves an intermediate convergence (maximum change of the density matrix smaller than 10−7 ) but then struggles to further refine the solution, exhibiting an oscillating behavior. As soon as the FLM iterations start, the energy error drops very rapidly until convergence is achieved.
